text: Absolutely, I recommend migrating to the new records platform. Evidence from option A highlights the vendor's provision of an audited rollback path at every migration step, ensuring comprehensive security and peace of mind during the transition. Option B underscores the automated cross-linking of case files, a feature unique to this platform that offers unmatched functionality for our operations. Moreover, the combined license fee drop by a third after consolidation aligns with strategic cost optimization goals. Lastly, the success of another sister office in a similar migration last spring adds significant confidence to the decision. Combining these factors, it becomes clear that adopting this platform would significantly enhance productivity and reduce costs while maintaining the highest standards of data integrity.
